verdict.rationale: Expensify documents its own Expensify Card program on a company-credit-card page, with spend control and 'Smart Limits on cards', which points to per-card limits. The pack never states that physical and virtual cards can be issued, or how fast issuance is. Missing for 10: documented physical card issuance, documented virtual card issuance, evidence of issuing to a team in minutes, detail on per-card limit configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can issue physical and virtual corporate cards to the team in minutes, each with its own spend limit

citations.quote: Control spend, automate compliance, and eliminate reimbursements.
even if you don't use the Expensify Card!
